name.en-US: Fables Composed for the Use of the Duke of Burgundy
name.pt-BR: Fábulas Compostas para o Uso do Duque de Borgonha

author.en-US: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon

description.en-US: Twenty-seven fables and tales Fénelon wrote to teach the young Duke of Burgundy, his pupil: moral histories of Aristonous, Alibeg, Florisa and others, and short animal fables, in James Elphinston's 1760 version.
description.pt-BR: Vinte e sete fábulas e contos que Fénelon escreveu para instruir o jovem duque de Borgonha: histórias morais de Aristonoo, Alibeg, Florisa e outras, e curtas fábulas de animais, na versão de James Elphinston (1760).

sources.edition: Fables composed for the use of the late Duke of Burgundy, tr. James Elphinston (London, 1760), Google Books scan on the Internet Archive; long-s OCR repaired by lexicon vote.
sources.description: The Medal, an epistle attributed to Bayle that follows the fables in the volume, is left out. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon died in 1715 and the edition is of 1760, so the text is public domain.
